headline: NEVGOLD DEFINES NEVADA'S LARGEST ANTIMONY RESOURCE — 48,100t Sb + 1.2Moz Gold Inferred at Limo Butte (OTC:NAUFF)
snippet: NevGold Corp. (OTC: NAUFF) released its maiden gold-antimony Mineral Resource Estimate for the Limo Butte Project in Nevada on July 15 — the first resource at Limo Butte in over 17 years — with 48,100 tonnes antimony Inferred at 0.18% and 1,203,500 oz gold Inferred at 0.32 g/t (16.9 Mt), plus 29,600t antimony and 181,400 oz gold Measured & Indicated. The company called it one of the largest strategic antimony resources in the United States, with China controlling most global antimony supply and the U.S. now classifying antimony as a critical defense and industrial mineral.

headline: VIZSLA COPPER: 472.8m AT 0.40% CuEq — 304.8m CORE AT 0.48% CONFIRMS THIRA AS MAJOR BC PORPHYRY (TSXV:VCU)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Vizsla Copper Corp.
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSXV: VCU) released Phase 1 spring 2026 results from the Thira porphyry discovery at its Poplar Project in central British Columbia, with hole TH26-154 returning 472.8 metres at 0.40% CuEq (0.26% Cu, 0.017% Mo, 0.87 g/t Ag, 0.04 g/t Au), including 304.8 metres at 0.48% CuEq — among the widest copper-equivalent intercepts from a new BC porphyry discovery this cycle. The Phase 1 results establish Thira as a genuine bulk-tonnage copper discovery in a highly prospective but underexplored belt of central British Columbia.

headline: ONYX GOLD HITS 3.5 g/t AU TO 700m DEPTH — Plus New Zone 250m NE; Munro-Croesus Keeps Expanding (TSXV:ONYX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Onyx Gold Corp.
snippet: Onyx Gold Corp. (TSXV: ONYX) reported 17 drill holes at its Munro-Croesus Project 75 km east of Timmins, Ontario, extending the high-grade Argus North zone from near-surface to over 700 metres of vertical depth — a remarkable depth extent for an Abitibi-style system. Hole MC26-274A returned 3.5 g/t gold over 28.1 metres including 5.3 g/t Au over 17.8 metres; a new mineralized trend was also identified 250 metres northeast of Argus Main along the Argus Fault corridor, opening a fresh exploration front.

headline: THOR SEGILOLA: 19,153 oz GOLD Q2, $225M CASH — On Track for 85,000 oz Guidance; Nigeria Mine Firing (TSXV:THX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Thor Explorations Ltd.
snippet: Thor Explorations Ltd. (TSXV/AIM: THX) reported Q2 2026 production of 19,153 ounces of gold from its Segilola Gold Mine in Nigeria — 240,769 tonnes milled at 2.57 g/t Au, with 17,050 oz sold at US$4,535/oz realized price and $77.3 million in revenue — finishing the quarter with $225.6 million in adjusted net cash including bullion inventory. The company maintained full-year guidance of 75,000–85,000 oz and is running 20,000 metres of exploration drilling across its Nigeria, Senegal, and Côte d'Ivoire portfolio.

headline: KUTCHO COPPER FIRST MULTI-TARGET DRILL IN 15+ YEARS — Feasibility-Stage BC VMS Tests 3 New Targets (TSXV:KC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Kutcho Copper Corp.
snippet: Kutcho Copper Corp. (TSXV: KC) commenced its 2026 exploration drill program at the feasibility-stage Kutcho copper-zinc VMS project in Northwest British Columbia — the first comprehensive multi-target program on the property in over 15 years — with two rigs testing the Hamburger, Gap, and Esso West targets via 11 holes each paired with down-hole EM surveys. Kutcho's recently completed feasibility study confirmed a C$1.14 billion NPV, and this program is designed to expand the resource ahead of a positive construction decision.

headline: MONTERO'S 625m HOLE HITS HIGH-SULPHIDATION SYSTEM AT ELVIRA — Dacite Porphyry Confirmed, N. Chile (TSXV:MON)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Montero Mining and Exploration
snippet: Montero Mining and Exploration Ltd. (TSXV: MON) completed drillhole MON-ELV-02 to 625.25 metres at the Elvira Gold Project in northern Chile — its first 2026 hole — confirming a predicted volcanic sequence overlying a dacite porphyry intrusion and an extensive pyrite-bearing high-sulphidation alteration system across the full hole length. High-sulphidation epithermal systems hosted by porphyry intrusions are the geological signature of large bulk-tonnage gold deposits; assay results are pending.

headline: NOA LITHIUM UPDATES ARGENTINA BRINE DRILLING — 2026 Rio Grande Program Active; Li Near Floor (TSXV:NOAL)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / NOA Lithium Brines Corp.
snippet: NOA Lithium Brines Corp. (TSXV: NOAL) updated progress on its 2026 exploration drill program at the Rio Grande Lithium Project in Salta Province, Argentina, advancing toward resource definition at a brine-hosted project in South America's lithium triangle. The update arrives as lithium carbonate prices hover near 2026 lows around CNY 154,000/t, though demand from Chinese EV battery producers and energy storage growth provides structural support for the commodity long term.

headline: SKYHARBOUR OPTIONS YURCHISON URANIUM TO PURECORE — Athabasca Basin Deal Expands District Reach (CSE:PURE)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Purecore Metals Inc.
snippet: Purecore Metals Inc. (CSE: PURE) signed a letter of intent with Skyharbour Resources Ltd. to acquire an option to earn up to 100% of the Yurchison Uranium Property in the Wollaston Domain of Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin — the world's highest-grade uranium district — adding another entry-point to the Basin as uranium spot prices hold above $85/lb and utility term contracting demand continues to build. The deal extends Skyharbour's strategy of seeding junior partners into Basin-area properties while expanding Purecore's Athabasca footprint.

headline: GOLDSEEK: GOLD-SILVER CORRECTION IS ENDING — Technical Analysis Declares Bottom In; $4,260 Target Before August
snippet: A technical analysis piece on GoldSeek argues that the recent pullback in gold and silver — which sent gold from the $4,260 area toward the $3,830 support floor — has concluded, with price action across multiple timeframes signaling the correction is over and the next leg higher is beginning. The analysis treats $3,830 as the critical structural floor whose defense sets up a run back toward $4,260 resistance, a breakout above which would open the path to fresh all-time highs ahead of the July 28–29 FOMC meeting.

headline: LUNDIN: MINERS IN SECOND INNING, NOT NINTH — Pullback Is Buying Window; Seasonal Low Due Mid-July to Mid-August
snippet: Gold Newsletter publisher Brien Lundin argues in a GoldSeek editorial that gold and silver mining stocks are presenting a rare generational entry point — with equities having a 'long, long way to go' despite twelve consecutive quarters of large year-over-year earnings growth — and that the current washout driven by Iran-related volatility and Fed rate-hike fears is the kind of sentiment extreme that precedes powerful sector advances. Lundin expects seasonal tailwinds to emerge between mid-July and mid-August, aligning with historical patterns for annual gold market cyclical lows.

headline: METALSOURCE TARGETS 2.4km VMS STRIKE AT SILVER HILL — Historic Core: 209 g/t Au, 241 g/t Ag; Drills Next (CSE:MSM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metalsource Mining Inc.
snippet: Metalsource Mining Inc. (CSE: MSM) identified approximately 2.4 kilometres of prospective VMS strike length at the historic Silver Hill mine in British Columbia through an induced polarization survey, with anomalies on-trend from mineralization where historic drill core returned composite assays up to 209 g/t gold, 241 g/t silver, 18.8% lead, 39.4% zinc, and 5.4% copper. The IP results define the drill-target priority sequence for the next phase of exploration at a past-producing property whose full strike extent has never been systematically tested with modern methods.
